# Slim 4 API Reference

> Complete bilingual API reference for Slim Framework v4.15.3 — every public class, interface, factory, PSR-17 provider, router, PSR-15 middleware, invocation strategy, error renderer, and HTTP exception.

- [Routing (Slim\Routing)](https://slim.drawlib.com/api/en/03_routing.html): The Slim\Routing namespace implements Slim 4's FastRoute-backed routing subsystem, covering route registration (RouteCollectorProxy, RouteCollector, Route…

- [Handlers & Invocation Strategies](https://slim.drawlib.com/api/en/05_handlers_and_strategies.html): The Slim\Handlers namespace provides the default ErrorHandler responsible for HTTP content negotiation, exception logging, and response generation, alongside…
- [Error Renderers](https://slim.drawlib.com/api/en/06_error_renderers.html): The Slim\Error and Slim\Error\Renderers namespaces define the base AbstractErrorRenderer and four concrete formatters implementing ErrorRendererInterface.…
- [HTTP Exceptions (Slim\Exception\*)](https://slim.drawlib.com/api/en/07_exceptions.html): The Slim\Exception namespace (11 classes across 11 files in Slim/Exception/) provides a strongly typed HTTP exception hierarchy rooted at PHP's SPL…
- [Contract Interfaces (Slim\Interfaces\*)](https://slim.drawlib.com/api/en/08_interfaces.html): The Slim\Interfaces namespace (17 interfaces across 17 files in Slim/Interfaces/) defines the complete architectural contract surface of Slim Framework…
